_comment: Reference of every PiDev/OpenACP setting and where it lives. PiDev reads its settings from .env (see .env.example); this file is documentation, not loaded at runtime.

pidev (.env, owned by PiDev).PIDEV_ALLOWED_USER_IDS: numeric Telegram user IDs; empty = nobody (fail closed). Also written into OpenACP security.allowedUserIds by 'pidev apply openacp'
pidev (.env, owned by PiDev).PIDEV_WORKSPACE_ROOT: absolute path; OpenACP instance lives at <root>/.openacp so OpenACP's workspace base == this root
pidev (.env, owned by PiDev).PIDEV_LOCK_TTL_MINUTES: idle minutes before a project write lock can be taken over
pidev (.env, owned by PiDev).LLM_PROVIDER: claude | openai | gemini -> OpenACP agent claude | codex | gemini (also sets OpenACP defaultAgent)
pidev (.env, owned by PiDev).LLM_MODEL: optional; claude -> managed policy `model`; gemini -> agents.json GEMINI_MODEL; openai -> manual (~/.codex/config.toml)
pidev (.env, owned by PiDev).LLM_API_KEY: optional; claude -> apiKeyHelper (bin/pidev-apikey.js); openai/gemini -> agents.json env OPENAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY

<root>/.openacp/agents.json.installed.<agent>.env: provider key / model env for the selected agent only; PiDev-managed vars removed from other agents

claude code (root-owned, rendered by 'pi./etc/claude-code/managed-settings.d/50-p: permissions (allow/ask/deny), bypass disabled, guard hook, sandbox, apiKeyHelper + model when LLM_PROVIDER=claude
